title: Get Yourself Optimized (Stephan Spencer) — 'How to Be Incorruptible with Eric Ries'
summary: Spencer hosts Get Yourself Optimized, a show on health, productivity and business, and had already interviewed Eric for his other podcast, Marketing Speak. Episode 568 covers mission guardianship, why structure protects a mission better than stated values, and the low-information diet.
blockquote: Most companies eventually give in to the pressure to maximize profit at any cost, but a rare few resist that pull entirely and stay true to their mission for decades.
